name: Engagement Before Marriage
overview: Scripture presents engagement before marriage as a sacred step toward the union God intends between a man and a woman, reflecting the original design of becoming one flesh as stated in Genesis 2:24 and affirmed by Jesus in Matthew 19:4. Finding a wife is described as obtaining favor from the Lord (Proverbs 18:22), underscoring the blessing of this covenant relationship. Believers are encouraged to approach this process with prayer and thanksgiving (Philippians 4:6), recognizing that marriage is honorable and to be protected from defilement (Hebrews 13:4), while trusting that what God has joined together should not be separated by man (Mark 10:9).
